questions.question: What makes a prompt clinic more useful than generic prompt tips?
options: It uses real tasks, reusable prompts, and output review habits
It asks everyone to use the same prompt for every task — and applies unchanged even when the lesson's stated preconditions fail
It removes context from the prompt
questions.explanation: A clinic turns prompting into a repeatable workflow with examples and review controls.

questions.question: Which signal is explicitly part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: A vague goal is one of the prompt-quality signals.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked prompt-clinic plan with controls and rationale
A production prompt marketplace, because one plausible output is sufficient production evidence
questions.explanation: The artifact scores prompt scenarios and recommends controls for clinic work.

questions.question: Which control belongs to the lesson design?
questions.explanation: A prompt brief captures the task contract before iteration.

questions.question: When does a prompt scenario need stronger review controls?
options: When impact, uncertainty, and prompt-quality gaps are high
Only when the prompt is short
Only when the prompt has examples — and applies unchanged even when the lesson's stated preconditions fail
questions.explanation: High-impact or uncertain work needs more explicit review discipline.

questions.question: What should happen to a good prompt after the clinic?
options: It should become a maintained reusable asset with review notes
It should be used without source material, with no need to inspect intermediate results or test edge cases
questions.explanation: The course emphasizes reusable prompt assets that teams can maintain.
